A '''Marine Biology Research Station''' was a type of station built for the purpose of conducting scientific research on [[Water/Legends|marine]] [[Species/Legends|organisms]]. [[Dorumaa Research Station]] was one such station located on the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dorumaa]].
